payload.content: {"url": "https://api.crossref.org/works?query=architectural+dimensions+of+communication+in+multi-agent+reinforcement+learning+and+coordination+stability&rows=4&select=DOI%2Ctitle%2Cabstract%2CURL%2Cpublished", "scope": "Crossref bibliographic metadata and abstracts where supplied; not full papers", "excerpt": "[{\"DOI\": \"10.1002/9781119699057.ch1\", \"title\": [\"Introduction\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.1002/9781119699057.ch1\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2020, 11, 6]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.5220/0006327305370545\", \"title\": [\"Multi-agent Coordination using Reinforcement Learning with a Relay Agent\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.5220/0006327305370545\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2017]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.2139/ssrn.7589171\", \"title\": [\"Communication-Aware Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Cooperative UAV Swarm Coordination in Bushfire Monitoring\"], \"abstract\": \"<jats:p>Autonomous UAV swarms require effective coordination and structured information exchange when operating under partial observability and communication constraints. This study presents a communication-aware multi-agent reinforcement learning framework, implemented as a CommNet–GAT fused variant of Multi-Agent Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (MADDPG), for collective coordination of Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) swarms in a simulated bushfire-monitoring task. The framework augments decentralised agent policies with range-constrained structured messages, CommNet-based neighbour aggregation, and an adaptive gating mechanism for fusing local and shared information. The approach is evaluated in a simulated partially observable disaster monitoring environment, using bushfire monitoring as a representative case study. The results show that explicit communication substantially improves cooperative fire detection, collision avoidance, and formation behaviour under the considered simulation conditions. The proposed fusion configuration achieved a fire-detection rate of 99.5\\\\% and reduced inter-agent and obstacle collisions relative to the no-communication configuration. Evaluation across a limited range of team sizes also indicated that the learned communication structure can be applied without changing the underlying actor architecture. These findings demonstrate the potential value of adaptive message fusion for communication-aware multi-agent coordination, while the results should be interpreted within the assumptions of the simplified two-dimensional simulation environment.</jats:p>\", \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.7589171\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2026]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.1109/access.2023.3275883\", \"title\": [\"Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Based on Representational Communication for Large-Scale Traffic Signal Control\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.1109/access.2023.3275883\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2023]]}}]", "excerpt_truncated": false, "source_sha256": "677040657576ee72dd4c1e0e60c0357686135b40f314cb290571eedd1f99f3f6", "verification_required": true, "topic_domain": "emergent_preferences", "evidence_role": "discovery", "host_tier": "discovery", "source_identity": null, "persistent_identifiers": ["doi:10.1002/9781119699057.ch1", "doi:10.5220/0006327305370545", "doi:10.2139/ssrn.7589171", "doi:10.1109/access.2023.3275883"], "source_candidates": ["https://doi.org/10.1002/9781119699057.ch1", "https://doi.org/10.5220/0006327305370545", "https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.7589171", "https://doi.org/10.1109/access.2023.3275883"], "source_candidate_identities": {}}
